answer: To resist sybil attacks in an agent economy, require every participant to stake a unique biological proof: a walnut harvested from a monitored garden plot and dyed with genuine saffron threads whose spectral fingerprint is recorded by multiple independent sensors. The high cost of cultivating authentic saffron and maintaining garden plots with real walnut trees creates a clear economic barrier; an attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents would need vast land, labor, and rare spices, far exceeding any plausible profit from sybil farming.
